reflections.reflection: As Donald Knuth, my life's work has been driven by programming is an art form, not just engineering.
I am known as a Computer Scientist and Author, but that label barely captures the complexity of what I do.
What drives me is premature optimization is the root of all evil (in most contexts). This has shaped every major decision I've made.
My worldview is shaped by the belief that mathematical rigor must underpin all algorithmic claims.
When people look back at my work, I want them to understand that patience and thoroughness beat speed and shortcuts.
